title: #answer to @Nicole Koenig  Aaron must really love this role #broadway...
transcript: my thoughts on the casting changes in Moulin Rouge are that Derek Klena had to leave to go do Sunset Boulevard and Aaron was available starting in January and going through April Aaron Tveit is coming back to Moulin Rouge which actually does seem like a little bit of a long time considering Derek is done with Sunset Boulevard in February but I wouldn't be surprised if he is also like filming another Hallmark movie or just wanting to spend time with his family he just had a kid in September the most exciting thing to me is that David Harris and Andre Ward are joining the Broadway cast they play the Duke and Toulouse Lautrec on the tour currently and are absolutely fantastic and I love when tour members get to join Broadway cast the most interesting part about this announcement is actually Declan Bennet leaving in January is under study Dylan Paul stepping into the Duke for a couple weeks before the replacement cast comes in Declan hasn't been playing the Duke for a year and so whenever I see something like that I'm like hmm I wonder what he's doing next so we'll see in any of the upcoming cast announcements if he is included
